subject: english
question:
Choose the option which is antonym of (opposite of) the word "dissonance" in the sentence given below:

After hours of negotiations, they finally reached a mutual agreement that satisfied both parties involved in the business deal.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **agreement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dissonance"** means a lack of harmony or agreement between things; a situation where things do not match or fit well together. (मतभेद)

 
 
• **Example: **There was a dissonance between their opinions on the project.
 
 
 
• **"Agreement" **refers to a situation in which people share the same opinion or reach a consensus; harmony in opinions or feelings. (समझौता)
 
 
• **Example: **After a long discussion, they finally reached an agreement.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'dissonance' **is **'agreement'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **agreement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deal** (सौदा): An agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics.

 
 
• **Example:** They closed the deal after several weeks of negotiations.
 
 
 
• **Mutual** (आपसी): Experienced or done by each of two or more parties toward the other or others.
 
 
• **Example: **They have a mutual respect for each other.
 
 
 
• **Negotiations** (वार्ता): Discussion aimed at reaching an agreement.
 
 
• **Example:** The negotiations took several days to complete.
